name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without strain, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility while keeping the ring thick enough for touch and low-vision users. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but it’s necessary to avoid missing focus entirely on high-contrast or small screens.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 4px ring at 7:1 contrast fails when users toggle *both* reduced motion *and* high-contrast mode—it disappears into the background. Better alternative: a 3px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow at 7:1, ensuring visibility in all modes. Settle by testing in both modes on real devices.
